theorem_scope: Actual prime, residue, inertia, and arithmetic Frobenius restriction from the algebraic closure of Q to arbitrary finite normal number fields; unramified Frobenius uniqueness away from the discriminant; independence of actual Frobenius witnesses and embedding choices; and the conditional equivalence between arithmetic prime coverage and the generic quotient-coverage input for separation. General Claim 9.1 remains partial because prescribed-conjugacy prime coverage in arbitrary finite Galois quotients is not proved. The arithmetic base of this block is Q; general-base source instances require corresponding attachment and coverage over F or a proved transfer.
status_counting_basis: Source theorem statements at their declared conditional scope; concrete arithmetic applications are not counted as completed.
restricted_arithmetic_result: General number-field attachment and choice-independence theorems, together with a conditional arithmetic coverage interface. These results do not supply general prescribed-conjugacy prime coverage or complete arithmetic Claim 9.1.
final_source_review_mode: Independent review of all new exact final production sources and their source-claim scope.
current_restricted_target: Actual Frobenius, inertia, residue, and prime restriction for arbitrary finite normal number fields, including unramified witness independence and the conditional arithmetic coverage equivalence.
